hints.title: Split into Words
hints.text: Split the input string s by spaces to obtain the individual words. Find max_len among all word lengths.

hints.title: Form Columns of Characters
hints.text: For column index c from 0 to max_len - 1, pick word[c] if c < len(word), otherwise pick a space.

hints.title: Strip Trailing Spaces
hints.text: Strip trailing whitespace from each column string before adding it to the result list.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def printVertically(self, s: str) -> list[str]:
        words = s.split()
        max_len = max(len(w) for w in words)
        res = []
        for c in range(max_len):
            col = "".join(w[c] if c < len(w) else " " for w in words)
            res.append(col.rstrip())
        return res
```
